title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
part_text: whereas in 2024, the CJEU issued three landmark judgments[[5]](#footnote-5) on gender-based violence and persecution, confirming that women and girls at risk of such violence, as well as of state-imposed discriminatory measures, qualify for refugee status on account of their gender;
